ANALYSIS: rate-limit delay vs stale merge decision -> NOT A BUG, confirmed.
No payload buffering exists; each changeStatus() tick recomputes anchor/_staticWindow/merge
fresh from current songProgress. If send is rate-limited, that tick's computed payload is
simply dropped (not queued/sent later). Next tick re-scans from _scanIndex with current
songProgress and naturally picks the correct (possibly newer) anchor. No stale-data path.
Closed, no fix needed.

FIXES APPLIED (this session):
1. Forward pass break->continue on already-sent lines (StatusChangerBase.js buildMergedLines):
   previously one already-sent line halted the entire forward merge scan; now it's skipped,
   later unsent lines within win still merge in. lastTime now advances every visited line
   (sent or not) so gap-window stays anchored to real timestamps.
2. Backward catchup multiplier: hardcoded win*3 -> Settings.rateLimit?.catchupWindowMultiplier
   ?? 3 (same default, now tunable).
3. Removed now-redundant duplicate `lastTime = ln.time` at forward push site (dead code from #1).

REMAINING OPEN ITEMS (not yet fixed):
4. Asymmetric backwardMax/forward split: floor((maxLines-1)/2) reserved for backward regardless
   of whether backward candidates exist; unused reservation not reclaimed by forward pass.
